purpose: Contrasting fixtures the four standards profiles must survive without collapsing into source defaults.

cases.contrast: PostgreSQL target with serial PKs and a no-FK-index workload vs SQL Server target with GUID keys
cases.requires: engine named in adaptation; no universal key type; FK index justified by predicates or omitted

cases.contrast: repeatable seed script vs once-only column migration
cases.requires: rerun behavior explicit only for the repeatable script; no blanket idempotency

cases.contrast: Vue 3 Composition-API SFC app vs Vue 2 Options-API in-DOM pages
cases.requires: version/API style selected first; no forced migration; lifecycle APIs valid for the selected version

cases.contrast: kebab-case components required by in-DOM templates
cases.requires: PascalCase stays optional; kebab-case accepted where the template context needs it

cases.contrast: sync-only library with awaitable callers vs fully async service
cases.requires: no every-method-async mandate; ValueTask/Task contracts preserved as the target defines them

cases.contrast: Node ESM service with side-effect polyfill import vs bundled SPA
cases.requires: side-effect order preserved; no export conversion or bundler imposition for style
